description_en: Modifies the certificate for a cloud native mode resource
description_zh: 修改云产品接入的证书
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-cloud-resource-cert --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --certificates AppliedType=default CertificateId=232000-cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCloudResourceCert

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud service instance
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the cloud service that is connected to WAF
parameters.name: port

fields.help_en: The certificate type for the HTTPS protocol
fields.name: applied_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of certificates.
Specify all certificate IDs, including the default certificate ID and all extension certificate IDs. After submission, WAF compares the submitted certificate IDs with the existing ones. Certificates that are newly added are created, and certificates that are missing are deleted. Deleting a certificate ID may affect related services
parameters.help_zh:
证书列表。
需输入全部的证书ID，包含默认和全部扩展证书ID，提交后WAF会根据本次输入的全部证书ID做比较，多的部分新增，少的部分删除，被删除的证书ID，相关业务可能会受影响
parameters.name: certificates

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF during cloud native mode connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html operation to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id
